searchText: Here is Teku's headliner position: https://hackmd.io/@teku/SJeW2JULlx <@&595685821026271242> Nimbus's headliner position: https://notes.status.im/s/dMrKGI_h9# Analysis of three Glamsterdam headliner proposals – ePBS, delayed execution, and shorter slot times: https://ethresear.ch/t/the-glamsterdam-equation/22760 Nethermind's team headliner position: https://hackmd.io/@nethermindclient/Syqj3VUUxg Besu team headliner opinion: https://hackmd.io/@RoboCopsGoneMad/Ski-5cHLge all client perspectives aggregated on forkcast now: https://forkcast.org/upgrade/glamsterdam#client-team-perspectives chose not to summarize or aggregate results within. imo, 1) the write-ups are already very accessible and to-the-point, and 2) preserving the nuance is more important than a pretty graphic zoom link? https://ethereumfoundation.zoom.us/j/88269836469?pwd=haUFXY28SNvw9pJ5CamxgMlMlghHac.1 See you in 5 🫡 **Stream** YT: https://youtube.com/watch?v=dkIQxIHX56E X: https://x.com/i/broadcasts/1OdKrDBpZLQJX Seems there were some folks in favor of alternatives to ePBS. Please publish your arguments by the next ACD. I believe most of the teams that prefer eBPS now would be happy to hear arguments for alternative approaches. https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7903 as brought up on the call. It's currently drafted with no limit but I'm considering adding a limit like 512kb or any placeholder Call recap on EthMagicians:https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/allcoredevs-execution-acde-216-july-17-2025/24770/4?u=timbeiko And shout out to Pooja for the excellent Twitter summary: https://x.com/poojaranjan19/status/1945845950859084276 😄
